comment: G4 spike runner profile (production-candidate). Default-deny, derived from src/worker/parser/seccomp.json (the admitted parser precedent) with additions a general CPython pure-function job measurably needs (file ops on tmpfs: mkdirat/unlinkat/renameat/renameat2/fchmod/fchmodat/umask; faccessat2; membarrier; restart_syscall; dup family; msync; chdir/fchdir; getgroups). execve is kept (the OCI runtime applies the filter before exec'ing the entrypoint, so denying it prevents container start); execveat stays denied. clone/clone3/fork/vfork/wait4 and all socket/connect/sendto syscalls are DENIED: no subprocesses, no threads, no network at syscall level (on top of --network none). This is spike evidence, not an admitted production profile.
